placeVerification.summary: Jordan, Minnesota is a real incorporated city in Scott County, MN. Population 6,656 (2020). Sits in the Minnesota River Valley, exurb ~35 miles from the Twin Cities. Named in 1855 after the Jordan River in Palestine.
placeVerification.genericNameWarning: The name 'Jordan' is extremely common: there is also Jordan, NY; Jordan, MT; the Jordan River; the country Jordan; and the surname is one of the most common in America (Michael Jordan). DENSITY-MAP itself admits multiple states match. A single bare 'Jordan' wink does NOT localize to Minnesota specifically; it is equally consistent with NY, MT, or no place at all.
